## One-sentence identity

Shubhanshu Shrimali is an AI-Native Systems and Game Engineer based in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India, who has shipped production games and apps to 300,000+ users with Top 10 genre rankings on iOS and Android, and who builds agent systems (LangGraph, Hermes, Graphify, vLLM) plus a custom C++/Vulkan engine (Eisen) and Unreal Engine 5 dedicated-server netcode.
